Virtusa Corporation – Consultant Chennai, India 02/2020 - Current

Liaise with business stakeholders in understanding & gathering requirements which come in the form of new enhancement or as a solution for production issues.
Gather raw data from upstream system,collate and aggregate the same in a more and push it to dashboard in a structured way specified by regulators
High level knowledge on calculation of Market Risk. • Having a constant check on the legal statements that are to be

Work closely with development team in making them understand the requirement and tracking the development status till production release. Perform UAT testing once development is done. Share the results with the business users and work with them to get sign off for production release.
Monitor daily production job status by monitoring automated mails
and running basic SQL queries.
Worked in cross border payments, direct debit payments, payment
workflow for UK Wealth Management clients Facilitate daily scrum call & sprint planning. Perform impact assessment at the early stage for every requirement with regards to the upstream & downstream teams. Prepare user journeys for various scenarios and multiple personas so that the team understands the requirement. Prepare functional requirement document for new enhancements and prepare project management artifacts for every production release like feature lists, test results, requirement traceability document. • Work with multiple different internal technology stakeholders like

BNP Paribas–Associate Level 1 Chennai, India 09/2019 - 12/2020
Trade Capture and Rates and Credit, FX payments and settlement. • Hands on experience in handling Asian clients and handling the risk that are involved in settling the cash flows.
Closely worked with Client relationship management teams to support the company and the clients incase of any new updates or enhancements being made in application perspective.
Has good knowledge in giving priorities for the sensitive currencies while
settling the trades.
Regular monitoring of impact assessment of the transactions that were released were analysed from our upstream and downstream systems. • Performing checks to all the payments and receivables are updated with correct beneficiary details and follow up with counter party incase of any mismatch.
Worked in cross border payments, SWIFT and in APAC Payments • Knowledge in clearing house and settlements. • Writing test cases of sample trades to be tested in Summit UAT environment • Working closely with IT team on the mapping of Trade details in Summit and client booking system
Review of test cases and validating with trade recap • Submissions of test reports to Client • Successfully reduced the manual work of up close to 2 hours by automation of products instead of manual capture.
BNY Mellon - Fund Accountant Chennai, India 11/2018 - 08/2019

Experience in calculating NAV for various funds Calculation of performance fees and management fees for different funds.
The Royal Bank of Scotland - Analyst Chennai, India 06/2015 - 07/2018
•
Trade Capture, Rates and Credit settlement. Involved in transitions from Manchester to India (Was onsite for 2 Months) Lead the team to grow from a team of two to eight.
• Working on Risk and control of the Settlements Process. Hands on Experience of handling End to End clients.
Worked on applications such as DTCC(Depository Trust Clearing Corporation), TLM
Monitoring of risk and controls to identify, access and manage any material risks which may arise. Ensuring the business is conducted within the risk appetite. • Ensure adequate business continuity plans are maintained and tested. • • Worked in various SWIFT message types(MT103,202) for transacting
international payments/cross border payments swiftly.
